title: Add a regression test for an already fixed bug
issue:
Add a regression test for #212

#212 (amounts with a thousands separator like "1,234.50" crashed the import with `decimal.InvalidOperation`) was fixed in 0.4.1, see CHANGELOG.md. The fix went in without a test, and last week someone almost reverted it while tidying `parse_amount`.

Please add a test that would have caught #212, so CI goes red if it ever comes back. The parser itself is fine now, so please don't change `ledger/amounts.py`; this PR should only add tests.

Tests run with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`.

checks.name: test fails when the fix is reverted
